OpenClaw 2026.11.11

Highlights

  • Fresh Knowledge chats: Accept the first message in a fresh chat with a large direct tool catalog instead of rejecting it as a context overflow; hard window checks and early compaction still apply. (#204925) Related #204902 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Clean conversation previews: Conversation versions and session previews no longer show stray backticks after linked inline code. (#204950) Related #204940 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Mattermost file captions: Long file captions keep named Markdown links intact instead of splitting them across posts. (#204955) Related #204939 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Linux updater feed: Release publication verifies public Linux updater download URLs before reusing them, so the updater feed does not point at an unavailable package. (#205044) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Release documentation: Stable closeout waits for the dispatched website deployment to appear before watching it, so release docs publication is confirmed rather than skipped. (#204906) Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

Changes

This maintenance release concentrates on the fixes below. Upcoming compatibility deadlines are listed after the fixes.

Fixes

  • Context budgeting: Price model-facing tool schemas without the generic JSON density premium, and price hard request admission from the projected request while padded preflight pressure only schedules maintenance. (#204925) Related #204902 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Message formatting: Keep linked inline code intact in plain-text conversation previews, and keep named links whole when long Mattermost file captions are chunked. (#204950, #204955) Related #204940, #204939 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Release and update reliability: Verify public Linux updater URLs before reusing them, and wait for the dispatched website run during stable closeout. (#205044, #204906) Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

Upcoming deprecations

These are compatibility review dates, not removals in this release. Doctor migrations and Plugin SDK shims marked removal-pending remain available until their documented conditions are met.
  • plugin-sdk-plugin-config-runtime-public-demotion — 2026-12-01: api.pluginConfig, runtime tool context config, and focused config-contracts, runtime-config-snapshot, or config-mutation subpaths; retain the public subpath through the 2026-12-01 window while official plugin consumers migrate (migration guide). Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • plugin-sdk-session-agent-resolution-aliases — 2026-11-29: resolveSessionAgentIdsStrict and resolveSessionAgentIdStrict with an explicit agent, agent-scoped session key, prepared fallback, or persisted owner (migration guide). Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • agent-harness-credential-prompt-string-argument — 2026-11-30: options object { controlToolsAvailable } (migration guide).
  • doctor-pre-july-retired-state — 2026-11-29: canonical SQLite state and byte-preserving archives for obsolete sources (migration guide).
  • doctor-context-budget-one-knob — 2026-11-29: models.providers..models[].contextTokens active-input caps and per-model contextWindow metadata (migration guide).
  • doctor-cli-backends-plugin-registration — 2026-11-29: registerCliBackend plugin registrations and model-scoped agentRuntime.id (migration guide).
  • doctor-model-compat-catalog-ownership — 2026-11-29: provider catalog compat metadata, with config compat reserved for custom routes (migration guide). Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • doctor-tier-eval-tranche — 2026-11-29: canonical config owners, shared SQLite state, built-in defaults, and plugin hooks (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-final-layout-polish — 2026-11-29: canonical final layout and built-in defaults (migration guide).
  • doctor-phase4-product-config-retirements — 2026-11-29: built-in rescue, marketplace, banner, and retired commitments behavior (migration guide).
  • doctor-media-models-consolidation — 2026-11-29: capability-tagged tools.media.models plus per-capability policy and defaults (migration guide).
  • doctor-runtime-tuning-knobs-purge — 2026-11-29: built-in runtime and channel defaults (migration guide).
  • doctor-phase2-channel-dm-aliases — 2026-11-29: dmPolicy and allowFrom at the same channel or account level (migration guide).
  • doctor-phase1-retired-runtime-config — 2026-11-29: canonical channel, media providerOptions, crossContext, and speakerVoice settings (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-root-default-model — 2026-11-29: agents.defaults.model (migration guide).
  • doctor-session-prune-reset-aliases — 2026-11-29: session.maintenance.pruneAfter; session.resetByType.direct (migration guide).
  • doctor-mcp-timeout-aliases — 2026-11-29: connectionTimeoutMs; requestTimeoutMs (migration guide).
  • doctor-cron-webhook-fallback — 2026-11-29: per-job delivery.to or delivery.completionDestination (migration guide).
  • doctor-canvas-host-root — 2026-11-29: plugins.entries.canvas.config.host (migration guide).
  • doctor-phase1-channel-noops-aliases — 2026-11-29: canonical channel settings or removal (migration guide).
  • doctor-memory-search-owner-consolidation — 2026-11-29: memory.search; agents.list[].memory.search (migration guide).
  • doctor-session-typing-mode-owner — 2026-11-29: agents.defaults.typingMode or agents.list[].typingMode (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • doctor-mcp-server-type-alias — 2026-11-29: mcp.servers.*.transport (migration guide).
  • doctor-gateway-bind-host-aliases — 2026-11-29: gateway.bind.mode values such as lan, loopback, custom, tailnet, and auto (migration guide).
  • doctor-audio-transcription-command — 2026-11-29: capability-tagged tools.media.models (migration guide).
  • doctor-channel-thread-binding-ttl — 2026-11-29: threadBindings.idleHours (migration guide).
  • doctor-channel-dm-aliases — 2026-11-29: channels..dmPolicy and channels..allowFrom (migration guide).
  • doctor-channel-streaming-aliases — 2026-11-29: channels..streaming.* (migration guide).
  • doctor-tts-top-level-owner — 2026-11-29: top-level tts (migration guide).
  • doctor-tts-provider-aliases — 2026-11-29: tts.providers. and microsoft instead of edge (migration guide).
  • doctor-tts-enabled-auto-mode — 2026-11-29: supported top-level/agents/channels/plugins TTS auto mode, for example auto: "always" or auto: "off" (migration guide).
  • doctor-tts-speaker-selection-fields — 2026-11-29: speakerVoice and speakerVoiceId (migration guide).
  • doctor-bundled-plugin-load-paths — 2026-11-29: packaged bundled plugins and the persisted plugin registry (migration guide).
  • doctor-bundled-provider-discovery-allowlist — 2026-11-29: plugins.bundledDiscovery allowlist mode plus explicit plugin/provider entries (migration guide).
  • doctor-codex-supervisor-plugin-config — 2026-11-29: plugins.entries.codex.config.supervision (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-web-search-plugin-config — 2026-11-29: plugins.entries..config.webSearch (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-web-fetch-plugin-config — 2026-11-29: plugins.entries.firecrawl.config.webFetch (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-x-search-plugin-config — 2026-11-29: plugins.entries.xai.config.webSearch.apiKey (migration guide). Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-talk-provider-shape — 2026-11-29: talk.providers. (migration guide).
  • doctor-legacy-tools-by-sender — 2026-11-29: typed id:, e164:, username:, or name: sender keys (migration guide).

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.10..d6ac32b1adb1eb9cd9ba8d28ffedc005d3a1cfa7 history: 7 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 7 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

Pull requests

  • PR #204906 Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • PR #205044 Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • PR #204969 Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • PR #204980 Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • PR #204955 Related #204939. Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • PR #204950 Related #204940. Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • PR #204925 Related #204902. Thanks @daniel-lxs.

View full changelog

OpenClaw 2026.11.10

Highlights

  • Safer updates: Schedule automatic updates, rehearse upgrades with the incoming release, and recover interrupted package or source updates without starting over. (#193713, #197922, #200273, #200366, #200460, #200866, #200994, #201009) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jacobtomlinson, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • ClawHub agent templates: Add an agent directly from a trusted ClawHub package, with settings in one CLAW.md manifest, bundled skills, and a durable setup chat. (#195707, #196322, #196348, #196392) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • OpenClaw ID: Link owner devices, connect nodes through the ID tunnel, and approve connections from Access. (#193982, #194007, #197628) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Browser handoff: Take over the agent’s browser from the Control UI Browser panel without stopping the agent. (#197928) Related #197902 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Chat controls: Steer a running conversation without stopping it, edit queued messages, and keep composer drafts across app restarts. (#193665, #197846, #197908) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Durable work on macOS: Keep durable background commands running even when the Gateway restarts. (#197474) Related #197443 Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @daniel-lxs.
  • Reliable delegation: Receive completed subagent results across Gateway restarts and while other children or descendants are still active. (#200279, #200649, #200823, #190999, #203102, #203176, #203222) Related #188422 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, and @esqandil.
  • OpenCode sign-in: Sign in to OpenCode Console or OpenCode Go in the browser and discover the models available to your account. (#202949, #202976) Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.

Changes

  • Access and permissions: Give guests sandboxed session tools and name invited members from their email so owners can identify them in Access. (#197748, #198491) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Templates: Add ClawHub templates by publisher and slug, and let template automations start paused until onboarding is complete. (#198479, #196323) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Tool discovery: Opt in to a usage-ranked index for finding agent tools, including MCP tools. (#197128, #198348) Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • Plugin side questions: Let plugins fork live conversation context for background turns with their own tools and policy-controlled file and command access. (#170146, #190950, #200636) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @RomneyDa.
  • MCP configuration: Apply MCP server changes saved from the CLI without stopping the Gateway. (#200582) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Webhooks: Accept request bodies up to 1 MiB and report rejected requests. (#200514) Thanks @garrytan and @obviyus.
  • Talk and images: Choose the speech-to-text model in Settings → Talk and have the agent review generated images before delivery. (#197906, #198227) Related #197859 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @daniel-lxs.
  • Providers: Support Parallel Decisions natively and through OpenRouter, and replace retired MiniMax M2 choices with the PDF-capable M3 integration. (#194537, #203998) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Model discovery: Respect the provider’s model list even on the Gateway’s first read, and show hosted model details in openclaw models list without a Gateway. (#202618, #202490) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • Codex: The bundled Codex app-server is now 0.172.0. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Managed installs: Keep releases in separate directories on OpenClaw-owned installations. (#198835) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • State upgrades: Copy and swap Gateway state at startup rather than migrating the live copy in place. (#198389) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • Backups: Show stage and byte progress for long-running backups and optionally omit retained Doctor migration originals from an archive. (#198675, #194823) Related #183277 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @etzelm, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @vyctorbrzezowski.

Fixes

  • Gateway access: Enforce the chat’s permission mode on Gateway-owned tools across runtimes, honor OpenClaw ID member permissions in HTTP history and connected apps, preserve requester and administrator access where appropriate, and prevent removed Discord DM senders from reusing an old session binding. (#202941, #200394, #194443, #196848, #199946, #200070) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @sallyom, @jjjhenriksen, @drobison00, and @joshavant.
  • Exec permissions: Enforce command environment restrictions consistently and deliver protected stdin values after asynchronous prompts. (#203934, #202646) Thanks @pgondhi987 and @obviyus.
  • Credentials and attachments: Preserve SecretRef-backed settings and avoid downloading Signal view-once attachments. (#197319, #201428, #196841) Related #175333 Thanks @mmaps, @anmol0b, @sallyom, @masatohoshino, and @drobison00.
  • Connection safety: Bind realtime voice streams to the signed call and keep configured web and workspace Azure requests on their intended destination. (#136506, #196847, #202031) Thanks @drobison00 and @mmaps.
  • Request ownership: Keep sessions assigned to the requester and send owner-targeted automation failures to the owner instead of the last chat. (#200952, #189953, #203409) Related #189947, #203403 Thanks @VACInc, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @obviyus, @chelsealong, and @nousclawds4.
  • Session recovery: Resume interrupted chats after a managed update replaces the running Gateway’s files, and answer after tool-only turns even when a context engine omits message timestamps. (#203185, #201766) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @VACInc, and @jalehman.
  • Delegated work: Wake yielded worktree turns once results are ready, make delivery failures visible, deliver finished results even when an access lookup fails, let resumed parents collect interrupted children, and acknowledge steering to busy children promptly. (#203113, #198807, #200760, #201460, #202139) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Queued conversations: Recheck a Discord sender’s access when their queued turn starts, show owners when a queued turn is withheld, and answer messages sent immediately after a delayed stop reply. (#202330, #200213, #200433, #201790) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Chat history: Keep the reader’s place as transcript ranges shrink, load older history after interrupted restoration, and preserve clipboard text during a paste. (#199747, #200107, #200098) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @VACInc, @sallyom, and @obviyus.
  • Automations: Hold onto scheduled work across session and Gateway changes, keep recovery moving while accepted work runs, and avoid duplicate replies or false failures after recovered, delegated, or intentionally silent results. (#200314, #199512, #200653, #201757, #203253, #201838, #202142, #164949) Related #200307, #200600, #202140, #164887, #203821 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @hannesrudolph, @daniel-lxs, @VACInc, @jayzhou2309, @Hensarj, and @ArthurBook.
  • Telegram: Keep receiving updates when their IDs reset and avoid replaying old topic context. (#201167, #202542, #202637) Thanks @obviyus and @VACInc.
  • Discord, Mattermost, and Feishu: Render Discord message edits like new sends, show agent callback buttons in Mattermost and Feishu, and deliver Mattermost taps once. (#199958, #201973) Related #190479 Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @yetval.
  • Slack and Teams: Deliver final Slack replies when native streaming hits a limit, suppress expired progress, and avoid duplicate or truncated Teams fallback replies. (#199849, #200080, #202368, #158429) Related #200045, #158103 Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @n1hility, @obviyus, @atlas-kring, @ericcaiwx-star, and @rdbartram.
  • Signal and Tlon: Preserve Signal mentions when quoting a message and require approval before responding in Tlon group DMs. (#200058, #202775) Related #195074 Thanks @VACInc, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @saariuslystoned, and @joshavant.
  • Voice and meetings: Keep meeting audio and captions active after join requests return, and support PostgreSQL-backed voice consultation indexes. (#191059, #178415, #202103) Related #173896, #178413 Thanks @valkyriweb, @obviyus, @jeremynorris, @sukhdeepjohar, and @VACInc.
  • Claude CLI and other native work: Preserve final replies after large tool outputs without redoing tool work on a fallback model, keep Gateway CLI run tools available after plugin reloads, and start fresh native work after the execution broker disconnects. (#166127, #200801, #202446, #203092) Related #200744 Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @VACInc, @daniel-lxs, @RTapiador, @fede-kamel, and @jzmudzinski.
  • Codex setup and conversations: Verify Codex during setup without requiring a runtime override, keep handoff moving even when a retired writer remains loaded, preserve oversized instructions and input, and handle same-name MCP servers. (#204296, #196172, #200690, #200735, #194831) Related #194825 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @daniel-lxs, @montrellcruse, @obviyus, @lonexreb, and @NicoBoom13.
  • OpenAI and ChatGPT: Retain system instructions on uncached ChatGPT Responses requests, recover replay-safe item conflicts, and restore GPT-6 Luna chat on the ChatGPT/Codex subscription route. (#202720, #200254, #201746) Related #202372, #201513 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @Avi974, @migelizaga-rgb, @MertBasar0, @obviyus, and @Caitoz.
  • Provider accounts and errors: Leave configured model rows unchanged when signing in again, stop retrying Anthropic requests that require credits, and leave healthy fallback models usable after missing-model errors. (#201742, #201997, #200946) Related #201558 Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @MertBasar0, @obviyus, @Caitoz, @LinzeShi, and @VACInc.
  • Provider compatibility and usage: Preserve reasoning across compatible proxy tool calls, keep steering in the correct input position, honor model-specific cooldowns and reasoning limits, and distinguish unknown pricing from free usage. (#202774, #198736, #203356, #200446, #199711, #201924) Related #199710 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @machine3at, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @JoshSalomon.
  • Tool and Code Mode output: Preserve required tool arguments, validate calls without silent truncation, retain foreground command output, and let silent commands reach their own timeout. (#200064, #201795, #202272, #202177, #202852, #200670) Related #202173 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @jalehman, @jacobtomlinson, @sasan1200, and @vincentkoc.
  • Browser screenshots: Capture background tabs in headed Chrome without losing screenshot support. (#202878) Related #165312 Thanks @obviyus and @titan550.
  • Control UI and native apps: Keep answers outside collapsed work details, improve mobile sidebar and keyboard behavior, restore Linux menus and model picker colors, and let Android Back dismiss the keyboard first while honoring allowed notification reply choices. (#197429, #202256, #201291, #202500, #201892, #202065, #195974) Related #202467, #195949 Thanks @Marvinthebored, @vyctorbrzezowski, @Peetiegonzalez, @obviyus, @Mezetix, @fuller-stack-dev, @saariuslystoned, and @Solvely-Colin.
  • Projects and worktrees: Let progressing Git clones continue, report Git time limits accurately, and keep delayed worktree clones and inherited project folders usable, and isolate sidebar sessions opened in managed clones. (#202924, #202525, #202839, #202792) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Gateway updates: Keep Settings → Updates usable after reconnecting, stop the previous Gateway cleanly after replacing its files or when it reran under a compatible Node version, and let updates proceed after read-only database access. (#203981, #203241, #203152, #204095) Related #203936, #204078 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Update safeguards: Refuse an update before changing the installation if a running node service holds the same state database or the package switch would replace a pnpm- or Bun-linked checkout still serving the Gateway. (#203578, #201701) Related #203457 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @wenyonglim.
  • Doctor and plugins: Finish Doctor after a package rollback, avoid copying state for offline update checks, remove empty canceled snapshots, and let updates finish with npm-installed provider plugins or plugins that do not ship Doctor code. (#203024, #202985, #203097, #204122, #204129) Related #203005, #203604 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @daniel-lxs, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @AS76.
  • Update recovery and reporting: Preserve the diagnostic trail and Inbox history of failed updates, distinguish repair from success, keep restart countdowns with the right update, retry owed plugin updates without ignoring Hold, and recognize version-like npm tags. (#202558, #202678, #202692, #201354, #200431, #201178, #201355, #201829) Related #202657 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @machine3at, @vincentkoc, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @VACInc, @sallyom, @AyhamJo7, @hannesrudolph, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Windows installs and updates: Replace an existing command wrapper on reinstall, bring the Gateway back after an update rollback, and replace migrated state databases without Windows file locks blocking the update. (#203588, #203264, #204094) Related #204085 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
  • Windows plugins and tools: Recognize plugin host junctions that point to the same directory despite different path capitalization, and keep managed GitHub command execution available in packaged installs. (#203147, #201712) Related #201589 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @welfo-beo, @JIRBOY, @bkudiess, and @RomneyDa.
  • macOS setup: Restore setup detection when running under bundled Bun. (#203177) Related #203124 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • PostgreSQL reliability: Start Gateways configured with plugin-backed secrets, reconnect and retry lease heartbeats after a dropped database connection, and keep scheduled Git backups current while the Gateway is running. (#201063, #201858, #201870) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @Staruy, and @VACInc.
  • Database upgrades and portability: Keep large agent databases registered after startup migrations, repair PostgreSQL schema metadata, support moves back to SQLite, preserve sequence behavior, and handle large plugin blobs during database transfers. (#203130, #197425, #200383, #201867, #201862, #201583) Related #196966, #200356, #201573 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @ceckert, @VACInc, @etzelm, @MasterSwords1, and @synapse-homeroot.
  • State and disk usage: Release SQLite snapshot disk space and avoid redundant state copies and filesystem checks during read-only inspection. (#201661, #202608, #202765, #203850) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Alix-007 and @vincentkoc.
  • First chats and long histories: Accept chats while model catalogs load, keep startup readiness responsive, and reduce memory and main-thread work when opening or compacting long transcripts. (#201127, #200370, #201304, #188397, #202234, #202547) Related #195361 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, and @garrytan.
  • Knowledge and memory: Improve Knowledge tool call shapes, keep background indexing progressing, and omit command wake output and unused tool lookups from search. (#200339, #202724, #201062, #201519) Related #196857 Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Ricardodpalmeida.

OpenClaw 2026.11.9

Highlights

  • Safer command and channel boundaries: Keep env -S shell-startup assignments visible to exec guards, enforce current Discord DM access before reusing an existing session binding, and keep self-hosted web tool redirects on their configured host. (#203934, #196848, #196847) Thanks @pgondhi987 and @drobison00.
  • Claude CLI background completions: Deliver secret input after an asynchronous stdin prompt, so direct Claude CLI background runs no longer fail with an unavailable secret descriptor. (#202646) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Tool Search on strict providers: Keep web_search through Tool Search working on chat-completions providers that reject assistant prefill. (#202436) Related #202415 Thanks @obviyus and @paulsimmondsplato.
  • Cheaper session forks: OpenAI session forks reuse the parent's prompt cache, and Anthropic forks stop writing cache checkpoints on their own one-off suffix. (#197226, #197224) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Complete ACP replies: ACP clients receive the whole reply when a prompt waits behind other work. (#202658) Thanks @obviyus.

Changes

This maintenance release concentrates on the fixes below. Upcoming compatibility deadlines are listed after the fixes.

Fixes

  • Command, channel, and web boundaries: Keep env -S payload assignments visible to blocked-key and shell-startup guards, apply current Discord DM pairing and allowlist policy before using a bound session, and confine self-hosted web endpoint redirects to the configured host. (#203934, #196848, #196847) Thanks @pgondhi987 and @drobison00.
  • Claude CLI and ACP delivery: Retain secret input pipes through asynchronous child readiness and deliver the complete final reply to ACP clients whose prompt was queued behind other work. (#202646, #202658) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Provider requests and prompt caching: Keep callable Tool Search history native on chat-completions providers, reuse the parent prompt cache for OpenAI session forks, and stop Anthropic forks from caching their own suffix. (#202436, #197226, #197224) Related #202415 Thanks @obviyus and @paulsimmondsplato.
  • Model configuration: Keep configured model rows, including explicit thinking-level entries, unchanged when you sign in to a provider again. (#201742) Related #201558 Thanks @MertBasar0, @obviyus, and @Caitoz.
  • Bundled Codex: Update the bundled Codex app-server to 0.172.0 and its generated app-server protocol. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Browser screenshots: Keep screenshots working for background tabs in headed Chrome instead of timing out and blocking later captures. (#202878) Related #165312 Thanks @obviyus and @titan550.

OpenClaw 2026.10.9

Highlights

  • Patch vulnerable runtime dependencies: fast-uri 4.2.3 rejects malformed URI schemes and hosts in MCP schema validation, oversized Zod collections are rejected early in A2UI and the Discord embedded app SDK, IMAP sender parsing uses nodemailer 10.1.4 so spoofed senders cannot pass the sender token gate, and Microsoft Teams uses patched MSAL Node 7.1.1. (#187294) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Apply tools.fs.workspaceOnly to Gateway-built tools, so delegate changes still require approval and media tools stay inside the workspace. (#185094) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @RomneyDa, and @shakkernerd.
  • Keep live credentials out of MCP CLI inspection and mask Google OAuth client secrets in logs. (#180321, #180308, #183193) Thanks @brandon-julio-t, @wr-web, @LeizhenZhang, and @RomneyDa.
  • Make failed update rollbacks safe: Git-source rollbacks preserve operator edits instead of resetting the checkout, and npm rollbacks retry transient Windows denials and report the exact move that restores a bootable install instead of stranding the package root. (#185201, #184887, #185160, #184889) Thanks @wr-web, @syxscott, @LiuwqGit, @shakkernerd, and @RomneyDa.
  • Recover intact agent databases and stale full-text indexes after SQLite tokenizer changes, including update snapshots. (#176234, #176220, #176833, #181206) Thanks @ndakota79 and @RomneyDa.
  • Repair publication-complete updates after a remount while retaining the original launcher and sealed recovery helper. (#186557, #186527) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @sennyhoney, and @RomneyDa.
  • Migrate large transcript archives without exceeding Node.js string limits. (#170853, #170847) Thanks @iamonlv426 and @RomneyDa.
  • Allow agents to recover after a full disk once space becomes available, without requiring a restart. (#176902) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Changes

This maintenance release focuses on security dependency patches, recovery, data preservation, and reliability fixes.

Fixes

  • Resolve local media in Codex steering messages from the session's own workspace instead of the agent's default workspace. (#181528) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Report uncertain process cleanup from buffered commands, such as local CLI speech providers, instead of presenting it as an ordinary command failure. (#184270, #184237) Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
  • Keep reapproved node connections alive by publishing the approval with its committed pairing facts before the request resumes. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Recover stopped Gateways when service activation cannot be verified; retain untouched-recovery behavior in Windows triage. (#172784, #181577, #181698) Thanks @SMF12138 and @RomneyDa.
  • Avoid uninstalling a Gateway service during a passive macOS stop when no service is installed. (#181257) Thanks @shakkernerd, @LiuwqGit, @eleqtrizit, @syxscott, and @RomneyDa.
  • Recover CLI Node runtimes when launched from the filesystem root, including launchd jobs. (#178112, #177739) Thanks @downingkeys and @RomneyDa.
  • Start new ACP sessions in the requested working directory instead of the default workspace. (#176852, #123557) Thanks @yinx65588-boop, @crappier, and @RomneyDa.
  • Prevent overlapping model refreshes from failing requests. (#179144) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Honor an explicit SSH port 22 in openclaw gateway probe --ssh instead of the alias's configured port. (#171092) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Keep skill metadata such as icons and homepages when an inline YAML metadata value has a trailing comment. (#171224) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @Takhoffman, and @RomneyDa.

OpenClaw 2026.10.8

Highlights

  • Updates that finish and recover: an ordinary post-update Doctor failure restarts the Gateway instead of leaving it stopped, an orphaned maintenance worker no longer blocks every CLI command and Gateway start, and updates no longer abort on ACL filesystems, Windows pnpm optional-dependency links, pnpm 10 global installs, debug console logging, or a missing legacy OAuth directory. (#180668, #181695, #181141, #181596, #181456, #182850, #180174) Thanks @hannesrudolph, @SMF12138, @rayluo88, @PonySlayer28, and @VN77-77VN.
  • Gateway service installs on every desktop: macOS recovers a loaded launchd registration whose plist was deleted, Linux installs under the Ubuntu default umask create a private state directory instead of being refused, and the macOS updater waits for the serving Gateway to release its databases before Doctor runs. (#180390, #179538, #182055) Thanks @avnishkirnalli and @XiaoPengYouCode.
  • Conversations keep accepting messages: killed runs release their restart-recovery fence, interrupted and just-accepted child sessions recover after a Gateway restart, inbound messages stop retrying forever when the reply runtime cannot publish, and the Control UI forgotten-send retry delivers the reply instead of an authoring error. (#181992, #178888, #181871, #181300, #182219) Thanks @najef1979-code, @handcraftrc-pixel, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
  • Startup and database resilience: startup work no longer inherits a closed SQLite reader scope, so models, chat metadata and channel replies stay available; transient lock contention during agent database startup is retried; and model catalogs stay available during skill runs. (#182615, #182446, #182385)
  • Security hardening: exec allowlist mode requires approval for test -v operand expansion, generic node invoke refuses browser proxy commands, sandboxed spawned children cannot run host CLI backends, the secret egress proxy rejects distrusted eMudhra chains, Fish Audio and Gradium errors no longer expose API keys, and deeply nested Tlon content can no longer stall the channel. (#180880, #179880, #178742, #179249, #178877, #177536) Thanks @eleqtrizit and @joshavant.
  • Windows exec and plugins: agent exec works under S4U scheduled tasks while Store PowerShell is installed, native plugins load on machines with Endpoint DLP, and Doctor recovers dangling dependency junctions and plugins on another filesystem. (#182898, #179949, #179549, #179445) Fixes #182652 Thanks @RomneyDa, @tre1d, @coaiMax, @paulcam206, @JIRBOY, and @ceckert.
  • Provider and model continuity: Codex turns keep their budget with older runtime plugins instead of silently falling back, Codex native child inference works after startup, OpenAI OAuth works with stale catalogs, Anthropic PDF analysis works with setup-token OAuth, a timed-out MCP session close no longer fails the next turn, and CLI history owner changes stop instead of silently replaying on another provider. (#182995, #176311, #181356, #178420, #182189, #180075) Fixes #181619 Thanks @RomneyDa, @kip-claw, @enki, @sasan1200, @sunlit-deng, @khensthoth, @aniketkrs, @goslingmanagment, @wr-web, and @teddashh.

Changes

  • Fresh OpenAI setup: first-run model metadata no longer restricts the model picker to one model. (#175945) Thanks @matthematics1137 and @jb-dev1.

Fixes

  • Channel accounts: default Slack, Google Chat, X, Nextcloud Talk and Zalo accounts keep starting and keep their secrets after a named account is added. (#176267, #180450, #182608) Thanks @555aaditya, @progerjkd, and @masatohoshino.
  • Slack: an isolated invalid_auth is retried before a socket-mode channel is disabled, and silent relay network drops reconnect. (#181056, #182368) Thanks @mushuiyu886 and @marns.
  • Matrix, Twitch, Zalo, iMessage and Feishu delivery: ordinary Matrix messages are no longer treated as text commands, Twitch sends normalize channel targets, Zalo DMs with URLs are handled, iMessage recovers after the Messages bridge dies, and Feishu quick-action cards send again. (#179506, #178480, #178938, #180900, #79832) Thanks @xiaopan-xydt, @doomy, @HeZ2z, @Takhoffman, @zzrs-xxxr, @namchamvinhcuu, and @xiabee.
  • Agent runs and providers: heartbeat loops stop when background commands finish, temporary Codex probe workers no longer accumulate, Codex native turns stay alive during host work, Claude CLI turns no longer stall 15 minutes when stream output hits its limit, provider stream errors surface immediately, and session admission races no longer trigger model fallback. (#179060, #167390, #181839, #159931, #117397, #179347) Fixes #178937, #181805, and #178000 Thanks @maxdjohnson, @sunlit-deng, @Terwox, @AINCHORS, @robertmsale, and @davidcittadini.
  • Voice and meetings: Discord realtime voice consults initialize their runtime, voice calls use the configured agent model, and long meeting talk-back replies keep their audio. (#179462, #181451, #178254) Thanks @shoaibulhaque, @yagizkus, @potoior, @BeyonceBot, and @sukhdeepjohar.
  • Remote access and history: Tailscale Serve and Funnel recover after tailscaled restarts, and cron history stays readable after provider changes. (#180081, #181311) Thanks @enki, @saariuslystoned, and @xtimor.
  • Doctor repairs: retained transcripts verify after heading repairs, and repair keeps the Codex host compaction model. (#179089, #179914) Thanks @mrsavingsblogspot-rgb and @LiuwqGit.
  • Plugins and nodes: older plugin debounce callbacks keep working, computer use accepts input results from older Mac nodes, and Memory Wiki keeps user Notes when OKF concepts disappear. (#118011, #137755, #179657)
  • Secrets and hooks: the 1Password secret provider accepts group-writable OpenClaw files, and concurrent session-memory captures no longer overwrite each other. (#181127, #181081) Thanks @jalehman, @jason-allen-oneal, and @yetval.
  • Doctor recovery messages: when Doctor cannot restore a Gateway it stopped, it prints the failure and how to start the Gateway. (#181941)
  • Codex native children and replies: completed or undeliverable child completions no longer replay or wedge parents, replies unblock after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups, final answers survive transient retries, settled turns without a mirrored prompt finalize, native tool declarations stay stable, queued chats recover after plugin reloads, submitted steering commits before terminal release, and Codex accepts managed loopback proxy defaults. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179099, #179050, #183286, #181779, #183077, #182104, #184062, #183232) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @wtfichigo, @mmartoccia, @Marvinthebored, @sukhdeepjohar, @jjjhenriksen, @aatreya, @ermaxinc, and @RomneyDa.
  • Claude CLI sessions: unrelated native tasks no longer hold the final answer, parent replies finish after nested background agents, a stopped first turn keeps its conversation, room events no longer reset sessions, operators can keep native Agent and Workflow tools, resumed sessions see conversation updates, and Claude CLI models stay available with saved subscriptions. (#170322, #182267, #181966, #182273, #183765, #183059, #179203) Thanks @cassthebandit, @VACInc, @goslingmanagment, @holgergruenhagen, @xiaopan-xydt, @Marvinthebored, @scarabone, @atomsmasher81, @josh-cornelius, and @teddashh.
  • Subagents and agent turns: model fallback stops after local runtime faults, recovered child results deliver after session reuse, private completion receipts reconcile after a restart, parents keep waiting for active collectors, batched tool calls settle before sessions_yield, delayed sessions_send replies are no longer cut at 4,096 characters, turns finish after tool-result recovery, messages sent during transcript rebuilds are recovered, and completed attempt callbacks are released. (#180042, #184069, #184041, #172959, #184021, #178271, #175685, #182666, #164843, #183884) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @danielsiemers, @johan-eilertsen, @jailbirt, @rjdotdev, @wr-web, @seriouslysean, @MSNexploder, and @PollyBot13.
  • Gateway stability and streaming: long HTML and JSX answers, crafted Teams HTML, and replies that look like tool calls no longer stall the Gateway; reasoning tags are withheld before streaming; silent turns no longer send rich payloads; channel restarts survive exited-run cancellation; the Gateway closes after forced plugin retirement; plugin service schedules outlive the scope that created them; and cold tool inventories no longer grow memory. (#175472, #183438, #183252, #182454, #129244, #182433, #181270, #182207, #178596) Thanks @JasonBuildAI, @LeizhenZhang, @zax0rz, @JOY, @0xtc23, @bguliano, @obviyus, and @wuqxuan.
  • Updates, installs and Doctor: Windows managed updates no longer lock themselves on TEMP aliases, the Windows installer runs through iex, updates complete during channel outages and keep accepted policy pins, stopped database backups allow readers, Doctor restores the Gateway after SIGHUP, keeps valid reseeded configs and inherited logins, repairs unsupported Node runtimes, recovers agents after deletion journal loss, restores plugin host links, handles very large retained histories, and uses less memory on large fleets. (#183622, #183145, #179471, #180505, #180827, #182901, #183703, #179726, #181618, #181804, #181140, #180414, #180792, #181465) Thanks @ryandle, @duyufansh2008, @waynegault, @csabatatrai, @samueltardieu, @4140leal-cw, @rybing7, @RomneyDa, @LiuwqGit, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
  • Sessions and storage: relative session stores resolve against the state directory, sessions archive through symlinked state paths, stale restart-recovery sources no longer wedge sessions, cron cleanup keeps live child sessions, archived Discord slash-command sessions restore in place, background plugin work keeps its SQLite reader, and session deletes reuse warm archive workers. (#182444, #181554, #180853, #179057, #168596, #179031, #171156, #175091, #183410) Thanks @erickj92, @Cloud-Ocean, @Oldrich333, and @PollyBot13.
  • Auth and providers: rate-limited profiles cool down only as long as the provider asks, shared OAuth refreshes past deleted peers, concurrent agents keep MCP tool access while an OAuth credential is leased, utility models no longer return thinking-only replies, custom GLM providers generate session titles, Kimi K3.1 Pro gets the K3 thinking and video controls, Bedrock Mantle GPT models route through Responses, Google streams recover, and native conversations survive a compaction fallback model. (#180280, #179205, #179997, #169920, #172580, #181923, #182437, #117194, #183282) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @WG-Mojo, @maliv2, @danielsiemers, @jacobtomlinson, @TommyLei666, @obviyus, @rayvader, and @pstarkgit.
  • Channels: Telegram and Mattermost default accounts keep their tokens after a named account is added, X accounts with capitalized keys can be managed and synced, iMessage stops answering its own self-chat replies, Feishu keeps streamed text across tool calls, Google Chat delivers remote attachments as links, Synology Chat stops reporting false delivery failures, Tlon recovers after network drops, and channel images a turn could not read are retried. (#183618, #182706, #183263, #183461, #183383, #182438, #182416, #177654, #178358, #183390) Thanks @555aaditya, @rodricksz4h5, @wangmiao0668000666, @nxmxbbd, @sukhdeepjohar, @felirami, @kentuscn, @jailbirt, @HootRock, @masatohoshino, @yetval, and @teddashh.
  • Voice, apps and browser: realtime Talk survives early output and brief Gateway stalls, GPT-Live Talk and Bun realtime voice use the managed proxy, oversized macOS recordings error instead of disconnecting the node, Android chat binds to an allowed agent, the Tauri app no longer crashes before the dashboard is ready, FaceTime accepts new calls after a disconnect, the Control UI detects dead Gateway links, and browser control no longer rewrites trusted-proxy Gateway auth or holds profile leases after timeouts. (#182919, #180572, #175886, #176567, #182593, #182767, #183841, #154230, #179101, #181620, #154246) Thanks @anmol0b, @StatsR4Losers, @kybrcore, @MertBasar0, @jalehman, @CheatosBu, @xiaopan-xydt, @dawidkulpa, @Solvely-Colin, @fuller-stack-dev, and @LLagoon3.

(#183571, #183148, #177518, #177825, #120943, #183064, #182823, #172843) Thanks @lonexreb, @Valkster70, @xiaopan-xydt, @2991495215, @masatohoshino, @jlapenna, @shakkernerd, @ericcaiwx-star, @treez-admin, and @obviyus.

  • Replay-safe session recovery: interrupted sessions now retain recovery provenance and unfinished tool outcomes, stopped conversations retire terminal recovery residue before accepting the next message, rejected Claude CLI drafts stay out of final replies, large child-completion batches stay within requester context, and Codex previews no longer block replies after a context refresh. (#153728, #168764, #172068, #177716, #176682, #176783, #176675, #159715, #181801) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @ruel225, @Oliver4Spot, @jjjhenriksen, @enki, @PennyVibe, @mbelinky, @RomneyDa, and @krjcolby-svg.
  • Safer update activation and recovery: verified activations remain successful through later maintenance or ledger errors, interrupted package updates resume safely, post-activation Doctor waits are bounded, stale receipts cannot veto a valid repair, and Windows deep or 8.3 state paths no longer abort onboarding or migration. (#181166, #181307, #173862, #167459, #172768, #172769, #181389) Thanks @najef1979-code, @agroman1993, @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
  • Database and worker continuity: maintenance refusals preserve peer readers and borrowers, incompatible retained agent databases stay isolated, empty transcript deletions skip unnecessary archive materialization, Bun admission deadlines remain thread-local, and worker shutdown completes after inventory retirement. (#175987, #179320, #170122, #171372, #172756, #168862) Thanks @LifeViwer, @Captain69G, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
  • Backup and state durability: snapshots retain supported legacy exec-approval policies, interrupted R2 verification and restores resume safely, config observation keeps the last-known-good snapshot during truncated writes, failed multi-file patches preserve earlier files, and Memory Wiki re-imports preserve human-authored notes. (#164297, #171292, #152565, #160409, #175707) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @davidcittadini, @LiuwqGit, @yetval, @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @cristianoc, and @brucemccurdy.
  • Operator control continuity: native computer control recovers after session expiry, late-attached GitHub operators can publish PRs, synchronous node output is not duplicated as a completion wake, cron announcements preserve CLI chats, and history maintenance reads identities before payloads. (#169385, #169400, #164511, #176218, #174530) Thanks @stackingrockss, @Gigaxel, @holgergruenhagen, @eliavb43, @wangmiao0668000666, @asikorskiy, and @RomneyDa.
  • Provider and plugin continuity: model refresh, configured-account readiness, GPT-5.6 tool turns, OpenRouter onboarding, incremental plugin loading, and faster external TypeScript plugin startup retain current state instead of rejecting valid setup or discarding providers. (#176709, #178522, #173366, #173292, #162226, #161267, #168391) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @eduardonunesfreire-rgb, @chandraveshchaudhari, @netcrazed, @obviyus, @jakeaadams, and @RomneyDa.
  • Managed integration reliability: saved Linux Gateway dashboards preserve pairing across restarts, slow macOS Talk runs retain their replies, app upgrades converge official plugins, Copilot setup verifies SDK-backed agents correctly, Claude CLI cache prefixes stay stable after child completion and retain context when caller-only tools appear or disappear, and passkey prompts no longer block headless browser clicks. (#158908, #164485, #174257, #163578, #172026, #178955, #170857) Thanks @dor-sr, @PollyBot13, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @lifuyue, @Marvinthebored, @VACInc, @trukhinyuri, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @wangmiao0668000666, @brucemccurdy, and @rsaeks.
  • Cross-platform app-managed upgrades: native state repair, recovery snapshots, Gateway runtime admission, and post-upgrade service recovery now converge without losing agent access across macOS and Windows. (#171508, #174297, #175007, #176174, #178155, #178779, #180010, #180576, #180769) Thanks @tjarrau-dev, @DonnieFi, @jayzhou2309, @lostsock1, @sglion777, @Almost-Certified-ops, @billpang1-sketch, and @RomneyDa.

Changes

  • Google models: add Gemini 4 Argon support. (#171852) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Update guidance: avoid irrelevant database-repair advice when a package manager is missing, and remove superseded warnings after a successful update. (#173293, #173395) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @sunlit-deng, and @bhedanikhilkumar-code.
  • macOS onboarding: allow fresh profiles to start the Gateway and complete automatic setup. (#173246) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Gateway logging: prevent a deleted or stale temporary log directory from wedging the Gateway at full CPU during date rollover. (#160433) Fixes #130807 Thanks @masatohoshino, @WadeOwenWatts, and @RomneyDa.
  • Control UI queue state: clear slash-steer chips after the queued command is consumed. (#180024) Thanks @RomneyDa.
